random_state: lda_seed of the SAP repeat. One initialisation, not a search over starts.
transform: log1p on the seven positive variables. Mean and standard deviation of the observed training-fold values. A missing value is 0 after that scaling, the training mean.
days: The calendar window of user_embeddings_checked_DB1_a0_summary.csv. Its length matches the embedding sequence used by the external-vocabulary alarm.
partition_check: outer and inner folds recomputed from seeds.csv and matched to partitions.csv
outcome_rule: 3/3 Kaplan-Meier at 365 days on training patients with Tiempo_obs_DB1 >= 28
youden: one cut per outer fold, on inner held-out decisions among the 1013 landmarks, lowest cut if tied
refit: Each outer test uses a k-means fitted on all 140 training patients of that fold. The 35 external patients are assigned only.
comparison_landmarks: 1013 (id, block) pairs frozen in the external-vocabulary decisiones.csv. The current decision_points.csv differs by six pairs, so it is not used here. Each repeat has 155 positive and 858 negative external landmarks.
